claim_judgments.rationale: C0000 accurately states the purpose of subchapter 8 FAM 801.2 as providing guidance on the use of IRLs and INs, directly reflecting the source text.
C0001 faithfully defines IRLs as personalized, standardized letters with date and signature blocks requesting additional info, docs, or action needed to process a passport application.
C0002 captures the mandatory duty to fully adjudicate the application prior to suspending to ensure addressing all issues.
C0003 preserves the statement regarding the careful crafting of IRLs to communicate statutory, regulatory, and other Department requirements clearly and accurately.

C0004 completely covers the prohibition on unilateral changes/alterations by passport agencies/centers without CA/PPT/S/A approval, as well as the extenuating circumstances case-by-case exception with agency/center management approval.
C0005 accurately states the requirement that Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs.
C0006 represents the authorization for Posts to modify IRL language to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.
C0007 correctly notes the negative statement that IRLs are not adjudicative guidance.
C0008 captures the sequential requirement that the passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with 8 FAM prior to selecting the appropriate IRL to address deficiencies.
C0009 captures the baseline definition that INs are standardized notices providing passport bearers with information about their passports.
C0010 captures the illustrative functions of INs (explaining validity limitation and/or required documentation).
C0011 captures the descriptive statement that INs are carefully crafted to communicate information clearly and accurately.

C0012 covers the prohibition against unilateral changes/alterations to INs at passport agencies/centers without CA/PPT/S/A approval, along with the case-by-case management approval exception in extenuating circumstances.
C0013 correctly states that INs do not require a response from the applicant.
C0014 accurately states that INs do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.
C0015 captures the permission for Posts to consult Passport Services' IRL and IN indexes or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.gov when tailoring correspondence.

The definition, purpose/examples, and clear communication objective of INs are jointly covered by C0009, C0010, and C0011.

The exemptions stating that INs do not require a response and do not need to be personalized are jointly covered by C0013 and C0014.
